Name: (CP) Unique Trash Responses
Author: kttygrls
Description:
[size=4]Now when NPCs catch you dumpster diving, they won't all say the same thing as each other.

[/size][size=3]It also changes the friendship effects (Default -25) depending on the NPC that catches you.
[/size]
[b]Some reaction examples:[/b]
[list]
[*]Abigail is amused,
[*]Sebastian doesn't care to notice,
[*]Emily supports recycling,
[*]Lewis expects better behavior of his residents.
[/list]
Most NPCs still won't like it, but the friendship effect has been changed so it won't have [i]as[/i] much of a negative effect on your friendship, if at all.
This depends on the NPC, so you still have to watch your surroundings, if you care about that.

This mod only affects NPCs who have schedules that cause them to walk near garbage cans, so it doesn't affect NPCs like the Wizard, Sandy, Dwarf, or Krobus.
It also doesn't affect Linus, he already has a unique reaction.

[b]This should not conflict with any dialogue mods,[/b] unless you have another mod that makes changes to vanilla NPCs' DumpsterDiveComment, DumpsterDiveFriendshipEffect, and/or DumpsterDiveEmote.

I hope there aren't any weird issues. am new. 
I hope to add Generic Mod Config compatibility in the future, but I thought I'd release it as-is anyway. Edit the files to your liking.

[size=2][i]Thanks [/i][/size][size=2][i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/156514218]AgentLyoko[/url] for helping me fix my initial attempt at this![/i][/size]
